packageRules.description: The devcontainer image follows .nvmrc, which is the Node LTS. Renovate cannot tell an LTS line from a current one for a Docker tag, and offered 26 while 24 was still the LTS, so the major is a hand edit made together with .nvmrc
TypeScript 7 is refused by `astro check`, which says to install TypeScript 6 instead. Revisit when @astrojs/check supports it, or when astro check gives way to @astrojs/ts-content-mapper
scholarly 1.7.11 imports bibtexparser.bibdatabase, removed in 2.x, and declares the dependency without an upper bound. Revisit when scholarly does
